problem: Specialists can mark a CO-50 appeal ready without the clinical-note reference and filing deadline the payer packet needs.
inScope: PR-1 kept off the appeal path

assumptions.text: The gate applies to CO-50 only.
Nobody can override the gate in v1.
A clinical-note reference is a non-empty DOC-### id.
The deadline is the date of service plus 90 days, and a blank deadline is missing.
The blocked action names the missing items.

requirements.statement: A CO-50 denial can be marked appeal-ready only when a clinical-note reference and a filing deadline are both present.
requirements.rationale: Those are the two fields the packet checker will look for.

requirements.statement: CO-16, CO-197, and CO-4 are unchanged by this gate.
requirements.rationale: The question round limited the gate to CO-50.

requirements.statement: PR-1 and OA-23 cannot be marked appeal-ready.
requirements.rationale: The demo table classes them as patient responsibility and informational.

requirements.statement: When the gate blocks, the specialist sees the names of the missing items.
requirements.rationale: A disabled control with no reason cannot be tested from the scenario.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A CO-50 denial with no clinical-note reference and a filing deadline
acceptanceCriteria.when: The specialist marks the appeal ready
acceptanceCriteria.then: The packet stays not ready and the missing item is the clinical-note reference

acceptanceCriteria.given: A CO-50 denial with a clinical-note reference and no filing deadline
acceptanceCriteria.when: The specialist marks the appeal ready
acceptanceCriteria.then: The packet stays not ready and the missing item is the filing deadline

acceptanceCriteria.given: A CO-50 denial with both a clinical-note reference and a filing deadline
acceptanceCriteria.when: The specialist marks the appeal ready

acceptanceCriteria.given: A CO-16 denial with neither field
acceptanceCriteria.when: The specialist marks the appeal ready
acceptanceCriteria.then: This gate does not require a clinical-note reference

acceptanceCriteria.when: The specialist looks for the appeal action
The specialist reads the ready action
acceptanceCriteria.then: The missing field names are visible

scenarios.startingState: CO-50 denial DEN-01 has a deadline and no DOC id
scenarios.expected: Ready stays off and clinical-note reference is named

scenarios.startingState: CO-50 denial has DOC-014 and a blank deadline
scenarios.expected: Ready stays off and filing deadline is named

scenarios.startingState: CO-50 denial has DOC-003 and a deadline

scenarios.expected: The CO-50 note rule is not applied

scenarios.startingState: A PR-1 line is on the remit
Summary is open and a CO-50 row is blocked
scenarios.expected: The missing item names are on the screen

screens.title: Workqueue
screens.purpose: Find the denial and its deadline risk

screens.title: Denial detail
screens.purpose: Read the next action and the checklist

carcReferences.nextAction: Appeal with the coverage policy and a clinical-note reference. Do not change the diagnosis code in this product.
Correct the missing element named by the remark and resubmit the claim.
Post the amount to patient responsibility. Do not open an appeal.
